# Wellset India Events & Promotions

> Wellset India Events and Promotions (est. 2006) is a pan-India BTL and brand activation agency. For over 20 years it has taken brands, messages, and experiences to people — from bustling metro malls to the deepest rural markets — through on-ground activations like nukkad natak (street theatre), van and mall activations, road shows, canopy setups, and government/NGO awareness campaigns. The agency has covered 2,500+ towns and cities across India, served 150+ brands, and executed 300+ campaigns for private companies, government bodies, and NGOs.

## Company

- [Home](https://www.wellsetindia.com/): Agency overview, reach statistics (2,500+ towns/cities, 150+ brands, 300+ campaigns), full service list, and client roster (Cadbury, Colgate, Dove, Honda, Dell, Punjab National Bank, Tata Power, Tata Swach, Indian Oil, HP, Oil India, Gail, India Post, Delhi Police, National Health Mission, NBCC, Indian Railways, Nickelodeon, Sony, BSES, Apollo, Jal Shakti, and others).
- [About Us](https://www.wellsetindia.com/about): Founded in 2006 with the vision of connecting brands and institutions with people through real, on-ground experiences rather than screen-based messages. Covers the agency's story, its approach (strategic planning, pan-India mobilization, precision execution, measurable impact), and why clients across both private and public sectors trust the agency (consistent delivery, pan-India accountability, private and public sector experience, responsible community engagement).
- [Contact](https://www.wellsetindia.com/contact): Office address, phone/WhatsApp, email, office location map, and an enquiry form to request a proposal for a campaign.

- IEC Activation Campaigns
- Mall Activation
- Road Shows
- Canopy Activations

- Corporate, RWA & Retail Engagements

- Conference, Events & Exhibition
- Government & NGO Awareness Campaigns
- Stall Fabrication
